args.author: agent:carbon-bacterium
args.body: a STATE resolves for a bacterium. Two fields have values because the design declared them, every other field is null with its reason, and each declared value carries kind "assumed" and the source the designer gave -- so nothing downstream can mistake a stated picogram for a weighed one. Before this a taxon base resolved no STATE at all and organism_get refused outright, which meant no scenario, no standing check and no physics could be asked about any organism outside the bundle.

detail.caveat: This document names a TAXON and carries a DECLARED parameter set: quantities the designer stated, each with a source saying where it came from. Nobody measured them on this organism, and the engine holds measured parameters only for the organisms in its bundle. Every declared value enters STATE with kind "assumed", so the weakest-input machinery and every model_confidence downstream carry the fact that a person stated it. A result computed from them is a statement about those declarations as much as about the organism; fields nobody declared stay null and the checks that need them still refuse.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
